Name: SystemWorks' Bundle Tweaks
Author: SystemWorks
Description:
[size=5]Requirements[/size]
[list][*]Stardew Valley 1.5
[*]SMAPI 3.8.0
[*]Content Patcher 1.19.1
[/list]
[size=5]Installation Guide[/size]
[list][*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI. ﻿
[/list]
[size=5]Configuration Settings[/size]
[list][*]LateGameBundleTweaks - default: false
[/list]
[size=5]What BundleTweaks Actually Does[/size]
[list][*]Modifies most all bundles to be better balanced throughout gameplay, offering opportunities (but not requirements) to use more alternatives to each bundle than vanilla.
[*]Restructures bundles to be better thematically aligned with each other
[*]Modifies existing rewards to have more progression, be more rewarding and motivating, and cover more areas of gameplay
[*]Offers late-game oriented bundles (toggle through config file) that require more, and sometime harder, items to complete - as well as modifying rewards to compensate.
[*]Designed to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5615]other[/url]﻿ SystemWorks mods, but very functional on its own.
[/list]
[size=5]Devlog[/size]
[list][*][url=https://www.dropbox.com/s/3k7640p1ej3cy6q/Devlog-BundleTweaks.txt?dl=0]Version 1.0.1a[/url]
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list][*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] - Compatible, but does not currently include SVE-exclusive items.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3444]Minerva's Harder Community Center Bundles[/url] - Not compatible.﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]The Love of Cooking[/url] - Compatible, but does not affect their new bundles or items﻿
[*]Any other mod that modifies the Community Center Bundles - Not compatible.
[/list][size=5]Planned Updates[/size]
1.0.x/1.x.x:
[list]
[*]Bug Fixes
[*]Balance Changes
[*]As of yet unseen updates as needed
[*]﻿Interactivity with future SystemWorks content packs
[/list]
[size=5]Known Issues[/size]
[list][*]Bundles now no longer reset when edited on an existing save, requiring a new save file to use this mod.
[*]Does not work with remixed bundles.
[/list][size=5]Our Discord[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://discord.gg/VHDRw47]SystemWorks on Discord[/url]
[/list]

Manifest.Description: Adjustments to bundles that are intended to be used with SystemWorks' content packs, or to rebalance normal play.
